paths.label: Coding agents
paths.title: You already use a coding agent
paths.summary: Run a first session in your own repository, see what CLIO Coder may do without asking and how to undo it, check a change against the tests you name, hand bounded work to the agents you already use, then leave a run unattended within limits.

paths.label: Science and HPC
paths.title: You write research code and run it on a cluster
paths.summary: Start in your own repository, follow a numerical fix from a failing test to recorded verification, let the agent submit and follow a Slurm job you asked for, keep a speed-up only when a measurement proves it and the answers still match, and coordinate workers on other machines over SSH.

paths.label: Local models
paths.title: You run your own models
paths.summary: Connect a model server with no account or key, choose models for conversation and for delegated work, read what each session cost and why a run stopped, carry a long task through a handoff without losing its decisions, then compare answers blind before you trust a ranking of your models.
